_read_me: Root House seed. Fill names as you learn them. Seat numbers: 1 you, 2 father, 3 mother, 4 father's father, 5 father's mother, 6 mother's father, 7 mother's mother, 8-15 great-grandparents (8,9 = parents of 4; 10,11 = parents of 5; 12,13 = parents of 6; 14,15 = parents of 7). Living people stay private: the worker only searches people you add, and the public page never shows living people.

stories.text: My great-grandmother came out of Canada.
open_questions: Whose great-grandmother: the mother's (seat 12-15 of the mother's lines) or the Chairman's (seat 8-15)?
Which side: mother's father line or mother's mother line?
Her first name, married surname and maiden surname
Roughly when she came and who came with her
